Polarity predicted fail-open. Reachability is the public Double. Consequence is an all-NaN density, not a refusal and not a uniform fallback. I did not run toTrack; that path is Estimate.observed(values(k)) and would publish Observed(NaN) if called.

This is the one remaining site of the eight that is a public-input live hole. The other five stay conditional behind AlignmentRow.of. I am not starting a fix on the classification bead. Say if you want a child bead on SupportDensity.bandwidth.
